mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by >2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a labor market that is too hot and will soon lead to wage inflation, causing the Fed to raise rates and depress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances where UNRATE drops below 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% y/y, it signals a supply crunch that will hurt corporate profits and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising inflation.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances where INDPRO growth slows by >2% y/y and CPI is above 3% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 50 basis point increase in the federal funds rate signals a hawkish Fed pivot that will tighten financial conditions and depress equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises by >50bps in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above a 1.2 million annualized rate signals overexuberant demand that will soon lead to a supply overhang and economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1.2 million.

mechanism_narrative: Steadily falling unemployment below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will soon drive wage inflation and Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances where UNRATE is below 5% and falling.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals impending economic weakness that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by falling industrial production.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances where the yield curve flattens below 50bps and INDPRO is falling y/y.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales below a 0.5% month-over-month growth rate signals a sudden demand shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising unemployment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances where RSAFS m/m growth is below 0.5% and UNRATE is rising.
